text: I tried requesting it online last week and received a confirmation email saying it would arrive at my address within 2–3 days after the transaction, but it still hasn’t arrived. So yesterday I went to MH as a walk-in. The actual process only took around 2 minutes, but I waited more than an hour for my number to be called. It’s better to go there before 8:00 AM. I arrived at MH around 8:30 AM.
